g.title: legend
g.text: Airline seat reservation with overbooking: ERD
Underlined = identifier. Double box = weak entity set. Double diamond = identifying relationship.
(min,max) = how many times one instance takes part. Arrowhead = the other side relates to at most one. Black arrow = ISA (subclass).
Dashed = enforced by the seat triggers, not by a foreign key (a seat belongs to an aircraft type, a booking to a flight).
